title: Joshua Bible Quiz - Chapter 15
description: Ten questions on Joshua 15: the borders and cities of Judah, Caleb's conquest, and Achsah's springs.

questions.text: Judah's lot reached southward to the border of which land?
questions.explanation: The lot for Judah reached to the border of Edom, to the wilderness of Zin southward.

questions.text: What was the east border of Judah?
questions.explanation: The east border was the Salt Sea, even to the end of the Jordan.

questions.text: Whose stone did the border go up to?
questions.explanation: The border went up to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben.

questions.text: Which city is also called "the Jebusite" in the border description?
questions.explanation: The border went up by the valley of the son of Hinnom to the side of the Jebusite, also called Jerusalem.

questions.text: Which three sons of Anak did Caleb drive out?
questions.explanation: Caleb drove out the three sons of Anak: Sheshai, Ahiman, and Talmai.
The name of Debir before was Kiriath Sepher.

questions.text: Who took Kiriath Sepher and received Achsah as his wife?
questions.explanation: Othniel the son of Kenaz, the brother of Caleb, took it, and Caleb gave him Achsah his daughter as wife.

questions.text: What did Caleb give Achsah when she asked for springs of water?
questions.explanation: Achsah asked for springs of water because she had been set in the land of the South, and Caleb gave her the upper springs and the lower springs.

answers.text: A flock of sheep and goats
The upper springs and the lower springs
A city in the hill country

questions.text: Which of these is listed among Judah's cities in the wilderness?
questions.explanation: The cities in the wilderness were Beth Arabah, Middin, Secacah, Nibshan, the City of Salt, and En Gedi.

questions.text: Whom could the children of Judah not drive out of Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: The children of Judah could not drive out the Jebusites, who live with them at Jerusalem to this day.
